verdict.rationale: Temporal is explicitly Workflows-as-Code rather than a no-code engine, so data passing and transformation between Activities happens in ordinary SDK code (functions). This gives developers full flexibility, but there is no documented expression or formula mapping layer aimed at ops users. Missing for 10: any documented expression/formula language for mapping data between steps, explicit docs on passing and transforming Activity inputs and outputs, a UI-level or low-code mapping facility for ops users, and independent corroboration.
